Class
Description
CsvItemStorageService

DashboardPanel

FoundItem
Concrete domain model representing an item that has been found and secured.
Item

ItemCategory
Enumeration representing predefined categories for lost and found items.
ItemDetailDialog

ItemStatus

ItemStorageService

ItemTableModel
Custom table model providing structured tabular data of Item records for the dashboard JTable.
LostFoundController

LostFoundManager
Core business logic and service manager for the Smart Lost & Found system.

Immutable value object holding analytical metrics for UI dashboard display.
LostItem

Main
Application entry point for the Smart Lost & Found Management System.
MainFrame
Main application window for the Smart Lost & Found Management System.
ReportFoundItemPanel
Intuitive form view for logging a newly discovered (Found) item.
ReportLostItemPanel
Intuitive form view for submitting a new Lost Item report.
UIUtils
UI Utilities class providing standard modern design tokens, color schemes, typography, component factories, and consistent spacing across the application.
UpdateStatusDialog

User
